remarks: Welcome to this exquisite Mid-Century Modern home, nestled on a private acre in the highly sought-after Old Hill neighborhood. This serene retreat is situated down a quiet drive off of a cul-de-sac, offering the perfect blend of privacy and convenience, walkable to many amenities, and minutes to town, train and schools.  The gracious foyer leads to an open floorplan with sitting area, large family room, featuring a cozy fireplace, and an elegant dining room. The spacious eat-in kitchen seamlessly flows into the living spaces as well as the outdoor patios and pool area. Off the kitchen, you'll find a versatile playroom or fifth bedroom, as well as a charming four-season sunroom, perfect for enjoying the outdoors year-round.  The luxurious primary suite is a true sanctuary, featuring a newly renovated spa bath complete with a sauna, sitting room and private patio. This spacious home boasts 4 additional well-appointed bedrooms, along with three additional full baths and a half bath.  Step outside to your backyard oasis, where you'll find a stunning Glen Gate pool with custom safety fencing available. The property also includes a separate yoga studio, a tranquil koi pond with fountain, and a detached oversized garage. The flat, park-like grounds provide a perfect setting for outdoor activities and quiet reflection.  This zen-like home has been meticulously maintained with numerous modern touches while preserving its original charm.
